```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)

rel <- read_csv(
  "../../data/derived/bewell_taxonomy_relAbun.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Subject.Number = as.character(Subject.Number),
    RelAbun = as.numeric(RelAbun)
  )

ipaq <- readRDS("../../data/derived/clinical_manuscript.rds")$subjects

```

### Figure 4D: 6-taxa representative boxplots
```{r}
# Prep
rel2 <- rel %>%
  mutate(
    term = gsub(".*\\|", "", Taxonomy),
    variable = factor(
      variable,
      levels = c("rP", "tP", "rB", "tB"),
      labels = c("Pre Placebo", "Post Placebo", "Pre BRB", "Post BRB")
    ),
    pretty_taxon = gsub("_", " ", gsub("^\\w__", "", term)))

# 6 taxa
top_taxa <- c(
  "s__Blautia_obeum",
  "s__Eubacterium_eligens",
  "s__Lachnospira_pectinoschiza",
  "s__Eubacterium_rectale",
  "g__Lachnospiraceae_unclassified",
  "s__Parabacteroides_goldsteinii"
)

box_df <- rel2 %>% filter(term %in% top_taxa)

p_box <- ggplot(box_df, aes(x = variable, y = RelAbun, fill = variable)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, size = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ pretty_taxon, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Relative abundance", fill = "") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_box
ggsave("../figures/fig4D.svg", p_box, height = 6, width = 14)


```

### Figure 4E: baseline PCA colored by BRB effect group
```{r}
# Load model results and define BRB-enriched taxa (unadjusted p < 0.05)
load("../../data/model_stats_BW.rda")  # creates model_res_BW

sig_taxa <- model_res_BW %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  pull(term) %>%
  unique()

# Combined abundance per subject for those taxa (BRB arm only rB/tB)
rel_sig <- rel %>%
  mutate(term = gsub(".*\\|", "", Taxonomy)) %>%
  filter(term %in% sig_taxa, variable %in% c("rB", "tB"))

combined_sig <- rel_sig %>%
  group_by(Subject.Number, variable) %>%
  summarise(total_abun = sum(RelAbun, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Define BRB effect group (>2-fold increase)
combined_wide <- combined_sig %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = total_abun) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rB) & !is.na(tB)) %>%
  mutate(
    fold_change = (tB + 1e-6) / (rB + 1e-6),
    brb_status  = if_else(fold_change >= 2, "altered by BRB", "not altered by BRB"),
    brb_status  = factor(brb_status, levels = c("not altered by BRB", "altered by BRB"))
  )

# Baseline (rB) abundance table (ALL taxa) for PCA
baseline_brb <- rel %>%
  mutate(term = gsub(".*\\|", "", Taxonomy)) %>%
  filter(variable == "rB") %>%
  semi_join(combined_wide %>% select(Subject.Number), by = "Subject.Number") %>%
  select(Subject.Number, term, RelAbun) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = RelAbun, values_fill = 0) %>%
  left_join(combined_wide %>% select(Subject.Number, brb_status), by = "Subject.Number") %>%
  filter(!is.na(brb_status))

# PCA
X <- baseline_brb %>% select(-Subject.Number, -brb_status) %>% as.matrix()
rownames(X) <- baseline_brb$Subject.Number
pca_res <- prcomp(X, scale. = TRUE)

scores <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  setNames(c("PC1", "PC2")) %>%
  mutate(brb_status = baseline_brb$brb_status)

# PERMANOVA p-value (Bray-Curtis on original abundances)
otu_baseline  <- baseline_brb %>% select(-Subject.Number, -brb_status)
meta_baseline <- baseline_brb %>% select(brb_status)
dist_baseline <- vegdist(otu_baseline, method = "bray")
adonis_res <- adonis2(dist_baseline ~ brb_status, data = meta_baseline)
adonis_p <- signif(adonis_res$`Pr(>F)`[1], 2)

# Plot with hulls (narrow polygons)
hulls <- scores %>%
  mutate(brb_status = baseline_brb$brb_status) %>%
  group_by(brb_status) %>%
  filter(n() >= 3) %>%
  slice(chull(PC1, PC2)) %>%
  ungroup()

p_pca <- ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2, color = brb_status)) +
  geom_polygon(
    data = hulls,
    aes(PC1, PC2, fill = brb_status),
    alpha = 0.20,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
    label = paste0("p = ", adonis_p),
    size = 4
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(color = "BRB effect group", fill = "BRB effect group")

p_pca
ggsave("../figures/fig4E.svg", p_pca, width = 6, height = 4)

```


```{r}
# Baseline PCA scores with subject IDs
pre_pc1 <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Subject.Number") %>%
  transmute(
    Subject.Number = as.character(Subject.Number),
    Pre_PC1 = PC1,
    Pre_PC2 = PC2
  )
```



```{r}
post_brb <- rel %>%
  mutate(term = gsub(".*\\|", "", Taxonomy)) %>%
  filter(
    variable == "tB",
    Subject.Number %in% pre_pc1$Subject.Number
  ) %>%
  group_by(Subject.Number, term) %>%
  summarise(
    RelAbun = sum(RelAbun, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term,
    values_from = RelAbun,
    values_fill = 0
  )
```

```{r}
activity_meta <- ipaq %>%
  mutate(subject_number = as.character(subject_number)) %>%
  filter(
    subject_number %in% combined_wide$Subject.Number,
    !is.na(IPAQscore)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metsTotal = METwalking + METmoderate + METvig + METmins,
    Activity = if_else(
      IPAQscore == "HEPA active" | metsTotal >= 5000,
      "Active",
      "Inactive"
    ),
    Subject.Number = subject_number
  ) %>%
  select(Subject.Number, Activity) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
adonis_meta <- post_brb %>%
  select(Subject.Number) %>%
  inner_join(activity_meta, by = "Subject.Number") %>%
  inner_join(pre_pc1, by = "Subject.Number") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Activity),
    !is.na(Pre_PC1)
  )
```

```{r}
table(adonis_meta$Activity)

nrow(adonis_meta)

anyDuplicated(adonis_meta$Subject.Number)
```

```{r}
post_mat <- post_brb %>%
  filter(Subject.Number %in% adonis_meta$Subject.Number) %>%
  arrange(match(Subject.Number, adonis_meta$Subject.Number)) %>%
  select(-Subject.Number) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(post_mat) <- adonis_meta$Subject.Number
```

```{r}
identical(
  rownames(post_mat),
  adonis_meta$Subject.Number
)
```

```{r}
post_mat <- post_mat[
  ,
  colSums(post_mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
  drop = FALSE
]
```

```{r}
post_bray <- vegdist(
  post_mat,
  method = "bray"
)
```

```{r}
adonis_activity <- adonis2(
  post_bray ~ Activity,
  data = adonis_meta,
  permutations = 9999
)

adonis_activity
```

```{r}
adonis_adjusted <- adonis2(
  post_bray ~ Pre_PC1 + Activity,
  data = adonis_meta,
  permutations = 9999,
  by = "margin"
)

adonis_adjusted
```

```{r}
activity_dispersion <- betadisper(
  post_bray,
  adonis_meta$Activity
)

permutest(
  activity_dispersion,
  permutations = 9999
)
```
